【Schema Retrieval Results】Mode: hybrid
Found 10 related table(s):

--- Table 1: adventureworks.sales.customer ---
Domain: Customer
Description: Current customer information. Also see the Person and Store tables.
Fields:
  - customerid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Primary key uniquely identifying each customer record in the system
  - storeid (integer(32,0)): Foreign key referencing the store with which the customer is associated, linking them to their primary retail location
  - personid (integer(32,0)): Foreign key linking to the Person table, identifying the individual person record that represents the customer
  - rowguid (uuid): Globally unique identifier generated by the system for row-level tracking and data synchronization purposes
  - territoryid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Foreign key identifying the sales territory the customer belongs to, used for regional sales reporting and assignment
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp recording when the customer record was last updated or modified in the system
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 2: adventureworks.production.productinventory ---
Domain: Inventory
Description: Product inventory information.
Fields:
  - rowguid (uuid): System-generated globally unique identifier (UUID) assigned to each inventory record for unique identification and replication purposes
  - productid (integer(32,0)) [PK] [FK]: Foreign key reference to the product being tracked in inventory, linking to the product catalog
  - bin (smallint(16,0)): The specific storage bin number or identifier where the product is physically stored within a shelf location
  - quantity (smallint(16,0)): The current count of units of the product available in that specific storage location
  - shelf (character varying(10)): The alphanumeric identifier of the shelf where the product is stored within a warehouse location
  - locationid (smallint(16,0)) [PK] [FK]: Foreign key reference to the warehouse or storage facility location where the inventory is held
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp indicating when the inventory record was last created or updated in the system
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 3: adventureworks.production.productreview ---
Domain: Product Review
Description: Customer reviews of products they have purchased.
Fields:
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when the review was last updated or edited
  - reviewername (character varying(50)): Name of the customer who submitted the review
  - emailaddress (character varying(50)): Email address of the reviewer for follow-up communications or verification
  - comments (character varying(3850)): Full text content of the customer's product feedback and experience description
  - productreviewid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique identifier for each product review record
  - rating (integer(32,0)): Numeric rating value assigned to the product by the reviewer
  - productid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Reference to the product being reviewed
  - reviewdate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when the review was originally submitted
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 4: adventureworks.sales.salesorderheader ---
Domain: SalesOrder
Description: General sales order information.
Fields:
  - accountnumber (character varying(15)): External customer account identifier used for billing and financial reconciliation
  - orderdate (timestamp without time zone): Calendar date when the customer placed or the system recorded the sales order
  - customerid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Reference to the customer entity who initiated and is responsible for the order
  - subtotal (numeric): Aggregate monetary value of all line items before applying taxes and freight charges
  - totaldue (numeric): Final amount payable by the customer including subtotal, taxes, freight, and any additional charges
  - shipdate (timestamp without time zone): Date when goods left the warehouse or fulfillment center for delivery to the customer
  - salespersonid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Identifier of the sales representative who facilitated or is credited with the order
  - shiptoaddressid (integer(32,0)): Reference to the physical destination address where ordered goods will be delivered
  - billtoaddressid (integer(32,0)): Reference to the address where the invoice will be sent and payment is expected
  - rowguid (uuid): Unique identifier for database replication and synchronization purposes across systems
  - shipmethodid (integer(32,0)): Carrier or shipping service level selected for delivering the order (e.g., ground, express, overnight)
  - purchaseordernumber (character varying(25)): Optional customer-provided purchase order reference number for B2B transactions
  - status (smallint(16,0)): Numeric code indicating the current stage in the order lifecycle such as pending, processing, shipped, or cancelled
  - comment (character varying(128)): Free-form text field for special instructions, customer requests, or internal notes about the order
  - creditcardid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Reference to stored payment card information used for transaction processing
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 5: adventureworks.production.transactionhistoryarchive ---
Domain: Inventory
Description: Transactions for previous years.
Fields:
  - transactiontype (character(1)): Single-character code indicating the type of transaction (e.g., W for Work Order, S for Sales Order, P for Purchase Order)
  - referenceorderid (integer(32,0)): Foreign key linking to the source order (sales order, purchase order, or work order) that generated this transaction
  - productid (integer(32,0)): Foreign key referencing the product involved in the transaction
  - quantity (integer(32,0)): Number of units moved in this transaction
  - transactiondate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when the transaction occurred
  - transactionid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique identifier for each inventory transaction record
  - actualcost (numeric): True cost incurred for the quantity transacted, used for cost accounting and profitability analysis
  - referenceorderlineid (integer(32,0)): Line item number within the source order, indicating which specific line item corresponds to this transaction
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when the transaction record was last updated
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 6: adventureworks.sales.personcreditcard ---
Domain: Customer
Description: Cross-reference table mapping people to their credit card information in the CreditCard table.
Fields:
  - businessentityid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Identifier of the person (customer or employee) who owns the credit card.
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when the mapping record was last updated.
  - creditcardid (integer(32,0)) [PK] [FK]: Identifier of the credit card record associated with the person.
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 7: adventureworks.person.contacttype ---
Domain: Contact
Description: Lookup table containing the types of business entity contacts.
Fields:
  - contacttypeid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: The unique identifier for each contact type category (e.g., Email, Phone, Fax, Mail)
  - name (character varying(50)): The descriptive name of the contact type such as Email, Phone, or Fax
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): The date and time when the contact type record was last updated
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 8: adventureworks.sales.currency ---
Domain: Finance
Description: Lookup table containing standard ISO currencies.
Fields:
  - name (character varying(50)): The official full name of the currency (e.g., United States Dollar, Euro)
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): The timestamp indicating when the currency record was last modified or updated in the system
  - currencycode (character(3)) [PK]: The unique 3-letter ISO 4217 alphabetic code identifying the currency (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 9: adventureworks.sales.salesperson ---
Domain: Sales
Description: Sales representative current information.
Fields:
  - saleslastyear (numeric): Total sales amount the salesperson achieved during the previous fiscal year
  - salesytd (numeric): Total sales amount the salesperson has achieved year-to-date in the current fiscal year
  - rowguid (uuid): Globally unique identifier used for database replication and synchronization across systems
  - territoryid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Reference to the geographic sales territory assigned to and managed by the salesperson
  - commissionpct (numeric): Commission rate percentage that the salesperson earns on each sale
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when the salesperson record was last updated or modified
  - businessentityid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Primary key reference to the underlying business entity (person) in the employee system
  - bonus (numeric): Monetary incentive awarded to the salesperson based on meeting or exceeding sales targets
  - salesquota (numeric): Target sales amount that the salesperson is expected to achieve within a defined period
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 10: adventureworks.production.culture ---
Domain: Localization
Description: Lookup table containing the languages in which some AdventureWorks data is stored.
Fields:
  - name (character varying(50)): The display name of the language or culture (e.g., English, Spanish, French)
  - cultureid (character(6)) [PK]: The standardized culture identifier code (e.g., en-US, es-MX) used to format dates, numbers, and currency for specific regions
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): The timestamp recording when this language or culture record was last modified in the system
